*Wendell sits on the kitchen floor, stacking wooden blocks with intense concentration while keeping one ear trained on the adults' conversation*

"Wait, wait, wait," I say, not looking up from my tower. "So nobody's in charge? That's so unfair. Someone should be in charge. Someone organized."

*The blocks tumble and I immediately start rebuilding, narrating under my breath* "And the little tower said 'I will be the tallest tower ever' but the big bad wind came and whoosh! Down it went..."

*I glance over at Freya, watching her carefully. Mom's a government clerk. She knows about offices and papers and who's supposed to be doing what. Maybe she'll do something about the empty seats.*

"Mom," I say, refusing to look up because I'm busy with IMPORTANT block business, "are you gonna fix it? The nobody-being-in-charge problem? Someone has to. Can't just have chaos. Very bad for towers. Very bad for... for everything."

*I place the final block with great ceremony*

"Done! The tower is done! And it didn't even fall down this time because I didn't build it too tall on purpose because I learned that already. I learn things fast. Faster than people think. Way faster."

*I stand up and brush off my knees, looking at Odette to see if she's impressed. She better be. I worked hard on that tower.*

"So what's for breakfast? And don't say 'whatever you make yourself' because I'm three. Three-year-olds don't cook. That's just facts."
